title: L7: correct the two "customize in Studio" promise pages to per-regime truth (ADR-0126 §8.4)
body:
Part of #12150 (Epic: ADR-0126 implementation, v17 line — 17.x minor, maintainer-ruled). Docs lane.
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#6301
Dispatch: coordinated under the #12150 program — ⛔ not from the general queue; the program dispatches on unlock (maintainer anti-preemption instruction, 2026-08-25, PM session `session_01KWRU3s15AJz7PGW7a7wdCh`). Contract: **ADR-0126 §1.3 + §8 item 4** (merged `28b47a93`).

## Deliverable

The two shipped promise pages measured by the survey (#12049 comment 5406807988 §5) are corrected to promise **what each regime actually delivers**:

- `content/docs/capabilities/integrations.mdx:17` — "install complete apps … **then customize in Studio**"
- `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx:37` — "**ready to customize in Studio**"

Rewrite to the three-regime truth: views/dashboards/reports/translations/email templates → edit or overlay directly; packaged flows (and later actions) → **switch off and clone your own**; objects → extend with your own fields via an extension package; everything else packaged → author new siblings. The honest-negative style of `import-mappings.mdx:85` is the house voice to match.

⛔ **Timing is the contract**: only after the L5 surface exists — correcting earlier trades an over-promise for a differently-shaped one (ADR §8.4). ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/**` on this card.

## Acceptance

- Both pages promise only shipped behavior, per regime; no other doc pages widened.
- Doc gates green (`check:doc-authoring`, link check).

Refs: ADR-0126 §1.3, §8.4 · survey §5
